correctness.rationale: For r active eigenspaces of SPD A and F=bb^T, at least 2r-1 distinct active Lyapunov eigenvalue sums prevent early breakdown. The exact CG solution polynomial has degree k-1 with leading coefficient (-1)^(k-1) product_{j=1}^k alpha_j, alpha_j>0. Its sum kernel has Vandermonde factorization with invertible antitriangular core C and determinant (-1)^{d(d+1)/2} c_d^{d+1} product binom(d,j); deformation to the antidiagonal determines inertia independently of lower coefficients. Congruences yield exactly (ceil(k/2),floor(k/2),n-k) for all k<=r. Exact X* is PSD with rank r by the exponential-integral Gram representation. The included rational CG, characteristic-root, determinant and polynomial-kernel checks passed (68 groups). The proof, not finite tests, covers all quantifiers.

value.rationale: A precise rank/inertia classification is a motivated structural refinement of the 2026 numerical Lyapunov rank-growth problem. It shows every unconstrained CG Gramian approximation with 2<=k<=r is *necessarily* indefinite, despite a PSD true solution, and quantifies the number of negative modes without spectral-conditioning hypotheses. This motivates choosing projected methods or PSD safeguards for controllability Gramians and gives exact early storage rank. No guarantee for floating-point or late stages is claimed.
